environment.description: Same ECS Fargate task and code deployed with CloudHSM PKCS#11 provider configured with CKA_DECRYPT attribute set on the wrapping key but the operational data-encryption key (DEK) is wrapped with an additional layer: the HSM's key usage policy (CKA_UNWRAP restricted via HMAC-based key derivation function bound to a usage context label 'notification-validated'). The CloudHSM custom key store has a key policy that requires the decrypt operation to include an AAD (Additional Authenticated Data) field containing a SHA-256 digest of a JSON Schema validation result. The SQS consumer's decrypt call passes AAD derived from schema validation of the decrypted inner envelope. Messages with CRLF sequences (\r\n) in string fields fail the JSON Schema pattern constraint (pattern: ^[^\r\n]*$) applied to recipient_name, subject, and reply_to fields. The schema validation is performed INSIDE the HSM's AES-GCM-SIV authenticated decryption boundary - if the AAD (schema digest) doesn't match, decryption fails with CKR_ENCRYPTED_DATA_INVALID. The app cannot bypass this because it never possesses the raw DEK - only the HSM can decrypt, and only when the AAD proves schema compliance.

config.hsm: AWS CloudHSM FIPS 140-2 Level 3, PKCS#11 with CKA_UNWRAP policy
config.hsm_key_policy: AES-256-GCM-SIV with mandatory AAD binding to JSON Schema validation digest
config.schema_validation: JSON Schema with pattern ^[^\r\n]*$ on recipient_name, subject, reply_to
config.key_material_access: CKA_EXTRACTABLE=false, CKA_SENSITIVE=true, app never sees DEK
config.network: VPC with NAT gateway, outbound SMTP allowed on port 587
